gaps.explanation: Statement p3 (printed p7) prints an 'Other Governmental Funds' column, and the trim has no schedule for it. Its Total Cash Receipts are 835,778: Property Taxes 118,361 + Intergovernmental - State 583,444 + In-lieu of Taxes 23 + Other Taxes 3 + Charges for Services 52,579 + Miscellaneous 81,368. Detail holds General 17,164,662 + Road/Bridge 4,319,702 + Inheritance Tax 1,143,913 + Federal Aid Secondary 7,108,970 = 29,737,247. 29,737,247 + 835,778 = 30,573,025 = the statement total.
